name: Lyra
description: An apprentice cartographer who hears the constellations sing. Her folded star atlas is the last light of a forgotten sky.

name: Professor Orion
description: Keeper of the observatory's oldest archive. A patient teacher whose protective star charts shelter the entire party.

name: Ember
description: A wandering swordswoman chasing the first sunrise. Her bright resolve sharpens every celestial attack.

name: Sylvie
description: The forest's gentle keeper, stitching moonflowers into spells. Her living constellations restore the party's mana.

name: Kael
description: A knight sworn to the space between stars. His gilded armor carries the names of every traveler he has protected.

name: Miri
description: An inventive chronomancer with a pocket full of impossible clocks. She lends a little borrowed time to every spell.
